title: Dry Needling Workshop
shortDesc: Screening, anatomy, consent and supervised dry needling practice for clinicians.
fullDesc: Screening, anatomy, consent and supervised dry needling practice for clinicians. The programme description includes safe needle handling, trigger-point identification and integration into a wider treatment plan. Practical training must be appropriate to participants’ qualifications and scope of practice.
highlights: Anatomy and safety principles for needle handling
Managing common side effects and contraindications
Integrating dry needling into treatment plans

title: Kinesio Taping Workshop
shortDesc: Practical taping applications, skin screening and discussion of clinical evidence.
fullDesc: Practical taping applications, skin screening and discussion of clinical evidence. The programme covers shoulder, knee, back and ankle applications. Participants discuss indications, alternatives and how to evaluate a patient’s response rather than assuming that taping is necessary.
highlights: Principles and mechanics of elastic taping
Taping for swelling and lymphatic drainage

title: Mulligan Techniques Hands-on Workshop
shortDesc: Mobilisation with movement, SNAGs and NAGs in supervised clinical practice.
fullDesc: Mobilisation with movement, SNAGs and NAGs in supervised clinical practice. The programme covers hand placement, glide direction and appropriate application to spine and peripheral joints. Clinical reasoning and patient response guide the choice of technique.
highlights: SNAGs and NAGs for the spine
Correct glide direction, grade and dosage

title: HVLA Chiropractic Workshop
shortDesc: An advanced workshop topic covering screening, consent and HVLA manipulation.
fullDesc: An advanced workshop topic covering screening, consent and HVLA manipulation. The original workshop title is retained in this archive. Discussion centres on contraindications, referral, informed consent and safe decision-making; attendance does not confer chiropractic registration or authorisation to practise outside an existing professional scope.
highlights: Screening, red flags and safety for manipulation
Cervical, thoracic and lumbar HVLA techniques

title: Cupping Therapy Workshop
shortDesc: Dry cupping techniques, hygiene, skin monitoring and discussion of limitations.
fullDesc: Dry cupping techniques, hygiene, skin monitoring and discussion of limitations. The programme description includes static and moving dry cupping, contraindications and combining treatment with active movement. Evidence limitations and possible skin effects should form part of the discussion.

title: Therapeutic Exercise & Clinical Rehab
shortDesc: Exercise selection, progression and meaningful rehabilitation goals.
fullDesc: Exercise selection, progression and meaningful rehabilitation goals. The programme covers loading, exercise dosage and return-to-activity decisions. Participants consider ways to make rehabilitation practical for patients and how to review response over time.
highlights: Principles of therapeutic loading and progression

title: Mulligan Technique — Hands-on Workshop
shortDesc: A practical session with Dr. Syed Mozaffar, combining principles, supervised clinical application and case discussion.
fullDesc: Join Dr. Syed Mozaffar for a hands-on workshop exploring the Mulligan Technique. The session brings together the theoretical basis of mobilisation with movement, practical clinical applications and discussion of the evidence. Participants can ask questions and connect technique selection to clinical reasoning.
highlights: Principles and theoretical basis of the Mulligan Technique
Hands-on practical training with clinical applications

title: Kinesiology Taping Techniques — Hands-on Workshop
shortDesc: A practical session exploring taping assessment, joint support applications and sports rehabilitation.
fullDesc: Join The Muscular Junction for a hands-on workshop on kinesiology taping techniques. The session covers assessment and taping fundamentals, pain relief and joint support applications, and examples from sports injury rehabilitation. The focus is on practical learning and thoughtful use within clinical care.
highlights: Pain relief and joint support applications
